announcement.quote: Nuveen Announces Equity Option Closed-End Fund Restructuring

deals.notes: Every 425 in the window has Nuveen Equity Premium Opportunity Fund as subject company and Nuveen Equity Premium Income Fund as filer. Meeting set for 2014-09-19, then repeatedly adjourned (to 2014-10-20, 2014-11-17, and per the 2014-11-18 425 'The Annual Meeting of Shareholders for Nuveen Equity Premium Opportunity Fund (JSN) has been adjourned to December 5, 2014.'). The window's last excerpts (DEF 14A 2015-02-17 and 2016-03-10) show only the acquirer's own cover page under the name Nuveen S&P 500 Buy-Write Income Fund (BXMX); none states how the proposal for JSN ended. The 2014-05-01 DEFA14A press release lists many funds as filers but its excerpt does not name other target-acquirer pairs for this acquirer.
